class.name: AudioMixerServer
class.brief_description: Server for global audio channels with queues, fades and cross-fades.

method.name: add_channel
method.description: Adds [param channel] under its [member AudioMixerChannel.channel_name]. If a channel with that name exists, its definition is replaced; its voices keep playing with the new volume and pitch, and its queue is kept.

method.name: change_index
method.description: Moves the queue cursor of [param channel] to [param index]. If the channel is playing, it cross-fades (with [constant FADE_CURVE_EQUAL_POWER]) to that entry over [param fade_time] seconds; a negative [param fade_time] uses [member AudioMixerChannel.default_fade_time], [code]0.0[/code] switches at once. If the channel is not playing, only the cursor moves and [method play] starts there.

method.name: clear_queue
method.description: Removes all queue entries of [param channel] and resets the cursor to [code]-1[/code]. A playing entry keeps playing until it ends.

method.name: cross_fade
method.description: Starts [param stream] (an [AudioStream] or a path) on [param channel] and fades it in over [param time] seconds while the current voice fades out and stops. The queue cursor does not change. With [constant FADE_CURVE_EQUAL_POWER], the loudness stays about the same during the cross-fade.

method.name: dequeue
method.description: Removes the queue entry at [param index] of [param channel], or the last entry if [param index] is negative. If the removed entry is the current one, it keeps playing, and the cursor moves to the entry before it, so [method next] plays the entry that followed.

method.name: enqueue
method.description: Adds [param stream] (an [AudioStream] or a path) to the queue of [param channel], at position [param at] or at the end if [param at] is negative or past the end. A path is not loaded until the entry plays.

method.name: execute
method.description: Runs [param command] on its channel and returns [constant OK], then emits [signal command_executed]. [method execute] calls the same methods as code does ([method play], [method stop], [method enqueue], [method cross_fade], ...); see [enum AudioCommand.Command] for which properties each command uses. A command that cannot run changes nothing, prints one error that names the command, and returns an error code: [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] (no channel, missing [member AudioCommand.stream_path] or [member AudioCommand.clip_name], pitch scale not above [code]0[/code]), [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] (unknown channel, nothing to play), [constant ERR_FILE_NOT_FOUND] (the stream file does not exist), [constant ERR_FILE_UNRECOGNIZED] (the file is not an [AudioStream]), [constant ERR_PARAMETER_RANGE_ERROR] (no queue entry at [member AudioCommand.queue_index]) or [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE] (the channel is not playing, or its stream is not an [AudioStreamInteractive]). Other channels are not affected. A stream is loaded on first use through the resource cache: it stays in memory while it plays (or while an [AudioCommandList] keeps it with [method AudioCommandList.preload_streams]) and is freed afterwards.

method.name: execute_group
method.description: Runs all registered commands whose [member AudioCommand.group] is [param group], in the order they were registered, for example all ambience commands of a forest. Every command runs even if one fails; returns the first error, or [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] if no registered command has that group.

method.name: execute_list
method.description: Runs all commands of [param list] in order, without registering them. Every command runs even if one fails; returns the first error.

method.name: execute_named
fade_in
method.description: Fades the current voice of [param channel] to full volume over [param time] seconds. If the channel is not playing, it starts the queue entry at the cursor (or the first entry) at volume [code]0[/code] and fades it in. Resumes a paused channel. Emits [signal fade_finished] when the fade ends.

method.name: fade_out
method.description: Fades the voices of [param channel] out over [param time] seconds and stops them at the end. One-shots stop at once. [method is_playing] returns [code]false[/code] from this call on. Emits [signal fade_finished] when the fade ends.

method.name: get_channel
method.description: Returns the definition of [param channel], or [code]null[/code] if it does not exist.

method.name: get_channel_names
method.description: Returns the names of all channels in the order they were added.

method.name: get_channel_pitch_scale
method.description: Returns the current pitch scale of [param channel].

method.name: get_channel_playback
method.description: Returns the playback of the current voice of [param channel], or [code]null[/code] if it is not playing. Use it to call methods of special playbacks, for example [AudioStreamGeneratorPlayback].

method.name: get_channel_volume_db
method.description: Returns the current volume of [param channel] in decibels, including the progress of a volume fade started with [method set_channel_volume_db].

method.name: get_command_names
method.description: Returns the names of all registered commands, in the order they were registered. Commands without a name are registered too (for [method execute_group]) but are not listed.

method.name: get_fade_gain
method.description: Returns the fade gain of the current voice of [param channel], from [code]0.0[/code] (silent) to [code]1.0[/code] (full volume), or [code]0.0[/code] if it is not playing.

method.name: get_index
method.description: Returns the queue cursor of [param channel]: the index of the current or last played entry, or [code]-1[/code] if no entry has played yet.

method.name: get_playback_position
method.description: Returns the position in seconds of the current voice of [param channel], or [code]0.0[/code] if it is not playing.

method.name: get_queue
method.description: Returns the paths of the queue entries of [param channel]. Entries added as an [AudioStream] without a path are returned as empty strings.

method.name: get_voice_count
method.description: Returns the number of voices of [param channel] that are playing or fading out, one-shots included.

method.name: has_channel
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a channel named [param channel] exists.

method.name: has_command
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a command named [param command_name] is registered.

method.name: is_fading
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a voice of [param channel] or its channel volume is fading.

method.name: is_paused
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param channel] is paused by [method pause] or, with [member AudioMixerChannel.pause_with_tree], by [member SceneTree.paused].

method.name: is_playing
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param channel] has a current voice, also while it is paused. Voices that fade out and one-shots do not count.

method.name: load_layout
method.description: Stops and removes all channels, then adds the channels of [param layout].

method.name: next
method.description: Moves to the next queue entry of [param channel] like [method change_index]. At the last entry, it starts again at the first one in [constant AudioMixerChannel.QUEUE_MODE_LOOP_QUEUE], picks a random other entry in [constant AudioMixerChannel.QUEUE_MODE_SHUFFLE], and does nothing in [constant AudioMixerChannel.QUEUE_MODE_STOP].

method.name: pause
method.description: Pauses all voices of [param channel]. Fades do not progress while the channel is paused.

method.name: play
method.description: Plays on [param channel] from [param from_position] seconds and stops the voices playing there. If [param stream] is [code]null[/code], plays the queue entry at the cursor (or the first entry); otherwise plays [param stream] (an [AudioStream] or a path) directly, without changing the queue. Resumes a paused channel. Emits [signal channel_started].

method.name: play_one_shot
method.description: Plays [param stream] (an [AudioStream] or a path) once on [param channel], next to the current voice, with an extra volume and pitch. At most [member AudioMixerChannel.polyphony] one-shots play at a time; the oldest one is stopped when another starts. One-shots emit no signals.

method.name: previous
method.description: Moves to the previous queue entry of [param channel] like [method change_index]. At the first entry, it moves to the last one, except in [constant AudioMixerChannel.QUEUE_MODE_STOP], where it does nothing.

method.name: register_commands
method.description: Registers the commands of [param list], so they can run by name with [method execute_named] and by group with [method execute_group]. The commands are kept by reference: later changes to a command take effect, but a changed [member AudioCommand.command_name] needs a new registration. If a name is already registered by another command, the new command replaces it and a warning is printed (so a later list, for example a mod, can override a command on purpose). A CSV file has no type of its own, so load it with the type hint [code]"AudioCommandList"[/code]: [codeblocks] [gdscript] var board = ResourceLoader.load("user://soundboard.csv", "AudioCommandList") AudioMixerServer.register_commands(board) [/gdscript] [csharp] var board = ResourceLoader.Load<AudioCommandList>("user://soundboard.csv", "AudioCommandList"); AudioMixerServer.RegisterCommands(board); [/csharp] [/codeblocks]

method.name: remove_channel
method.description: Stops all voices of [param channel] and removes it.

method.name: resume
method.description: Resumes the voices of [param channel] paused by [method pause]. A channel paused by [member SceneTree.paused] stays paused until the tree resumes.

method.name: seek
method.description: Restarts the current voice of [param channel] at [param position] seconds, like [method AudioStreamPlayer.seek].

method.name: set_channel_pitch_scale
method.description: Sets the pitch scale of [param channel] and all its voices. Must be greater than [code]0.0[/code].

method.name: set_channel_volume_db
method.description: Sets the volume of [param channel] in decibels, at once or, if [param fade_time] is greater than [code]0.0[/code], linearly in decibels over [param fade_time] seconds. Emits [signal fade_finished] when a fade ends. The volume of the bus is not changed.

method.name: stop
method.description: Stops the voices of [param channel], at once or with a linear fade-out of [param fade_time] seconds. One-shots stop at once. The queue and its cursor are kept.

method.name: stop_all
method.description: Calls [method stop] on all channels.

method.name: switch_clip
method.description: Switches the current voice of [param channel] to the clip named [param clip], if the voice plays an [AudioStreamInteractive] (module [code]interactive_music[/code]). Prints an error for other streams.

method.name: unregister_commands
method.description: Removes the commands of [param list] from the registered commands. A name that another list registered later stays registered; a name that this list had replaced is not restored.

signal.name: channel_finished
signal.description: Emitted when the current voice of [param channel] reaches the end of its stream. [param index] is the queue index of the entry, or [code]-1[/code] if the stream was played directly. Not emitted for voices that are stopped or faded out.

signal.name: channel_started
signal.description: Emitted when a new current voice starts on [param channel], by a call or by the queue. [param index] is the queue index, or [code]-1[/code] if the stream was played directly. [param stream_path] is empty for streams without a path.

signal.name: command_executed
signal.description: Emitted after [param command] ran successfully through [method execute], [method execute_list], [method execute_named] or [method execute_group]. [param command_name] is its [member AudioCommand.command_name] (empty for unnamed commands).

signal.name: fade_finished
signal.description: Emitted when a fade of [param channel] ends: a fade-in, a fade-out, a cross-fade or a volume fade. Emitted at most once per frame and channel.

signal.name: queue_finished
signal.description: Emitted when the last queue entry of [param channel] ends in [constant AudioMixerChannel.QUEUE_MODE_STOP].

constants.constant: The volume changes at a constant rate.
The volume changes slowly at first and fast at the end (quadratic).
The volume changes fast at first and slowly at the end (quadratic).
Rising volumes follow a sine and falling volumes a cosine, so the summed power of a cross-fade stays constant. The default of [method cross_fade].
